name: once-upon-a-diff
description: Once Upon a Diff's local bridge and its CLI (once-upon): serves stories to the extension and the local page, and takes requests for Claude sessions

scripts.test:extension: node bin/node-version.mjs && yarn workspace @once-upon-a-diff/extension build && node test/browser/load-test.ts
scripts.test:expand: node bin/node-version.mjs && yarn workspace @once-upon-a-diff/extension build && node test/browser/expand-test.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/browser/tsconfig.json
